transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because the district added this bilingual social-emotional learning rollout on top of my regular teaching. I’m still getting through the days, but I feel unusually wound up and discouraged. And I’ve started putting off lesson plans and emails that I normally would just handle.
Can you tell me roughly when these feelings of being 'wound up and discouraged' first started, in relation to when the new bilingual program rollout began?
Within the first month or two after they added it to my regular load, I started feeling unlike myself. Before that, I was managing my usual work and other commitments pretty well.
Over the past couple of months, have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in activities you used to enjoy, occurring nearly every day?
I haven’t really noticed that, no. I’m still interested in the things I usually enjoy.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about other areas of your life—like finances, health, or family—or does the anxious, wound-up feeling seem tied specifically to the situation at work?
It seems tied specifically to work—the added bilingual rollout and trying to keep up with my regular teaching. I don’t feel like I’m worrying broadly about everything else.
Besides feeling wound up, have you also been feeling sad, down, or hopeless most days?
I’m not sure I’d say most days. I do get discouraged about the work situation, but I haven’t really felt hopeless.
Have you been experiencing feelings of worthlessness or being overly critical of yourself since this all started?
No, I haven’t really been feeling worthless or beating myself up like that.
Would you say these feelings of being wound up, discouraged, and behind on tasks are noticeably affecting your ability to perform at work or in your personal life?
I’m still teaching and meeting the basic responsibilities, but I’ve missed or pushed back planning deadlines. I’ve also needed reminders from colleagues for tasks I used to stay on top of reliably.
How long in total have you been experiencing this wound-up, discouraged feeling since it started a couple of months ago—has it been continuous, or has it come and gone?
It’s been about five months now, since the district gave me that rollout role in the middle of the year. It’s been pretty ongoing since then.
